region: Burdett · Seneca Lake, Finger Lakes, New York
about: Ryan William Vineyard is Ryan Bossert’s farm winery in Burdett, on the east side of Seneca Lake in Schuyler County. The property brings together a vineyard, a winery, a tasting room and a restaurant, the Tasting Barn, with a patio looking out over the water. The winery’s profile rose sharply in August 2026, when its 2025 Pinot Blanc was named best in show at the New York Wine Classic and awarded the Governor’s Cup.

Gewürztraminer is a pink-skinned grape best known from Alsace, prized for its heady perfume of lychee, rose and spice. It needs a long, cool season to keep that perfume fresh rather than heavy, which Seneca Lake’s moderating waters provide. This bottling is from the Seneca Lake appellation and made dry. Expect Asian pear, rosewater and honeysuckle on the nose, and candied orange, spice and a touch of white pepper on the palate. With a few years in bottle, expect the fruit to have softened into more honeyed, spicy tones.
